The Koroks made this bow for Hylians. It's crafted from flexible wood and uses sturdy vines for the bowstring. Its construction may be simple, but it fires multiple arrows at once.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Forest Dweller's Bow'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 15 |durability = 35 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Forest Dweller's Bow}} Forest Dweller's Bows are [[Bow]]s made by [[Korok]]s for use by [[Hylian]]s. As a result, they can commonly be found in the [[Korok Forest]], but they can be found in [[Treasure Chest]]s on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and [[Hyrule Ridge]] as well. These Bows belong to the [[Korok Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} They are crafted from flexible wood, and the bowstring is made from sturdy vines. Forest Dweller's Bows are capable of firing three [[Arrow]]s at once in trade for only dealing a smaller amount of damage per hit. They have a slightly slowed Arrow flight speed compared to other Bows, with Arrows fired from them travelling roughly 11% slower. A Forest Dweller's Bow is one of the [[Weapon]]s given to [[Link]] during "[[The Test of Wood]]" [[Shrine Quest]], with which he must fight his way to the [[Maag Halan Shrine]].{{Cite|But it's not complicated—all you need to do is equip the {{Color BotW|Red|Korok weapon set}} and reach the shrine at the back of the area.|Damia|BotW}} The other two weapons are the [[Forest Dweller's Shield]] and [[Forest Dweller's Sword]]. If any of these [[Item]]s are switched out or break, the trial is over and must be restarted.{{Cite|You have to keep the {{Color BotW|Red|sword}}, {{Color BotW|Red|bow}}, and {{Color BotW|Red|shield}} equipped the whole time. If they break or you unequip them, you're out!|Damia|BotW}} Being made of wood, Forest Dweller's Bows will burn if they touch [[Fire]] or if they are equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_013" |Life = 35 |Power = 15 |Range = 20.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 7 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 8 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = true |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = true |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 3.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.6 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Forest Dweller's Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} ==Trivia== * The Forest Dweller's Bow's ability to fire multiple [[Arrow]]s may be a reference to the [[Kokiri Clothes]] from {{TFH}}, which also allow Link to fire three arrows at once when he wears them. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Bow * Korok Gear }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Bows, Korok Gear, Weapons |items= BotW, TotK }}
